description: NaB(HO)₆H₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. The structure is one-dimensional and consists of two H₂ clusters and one NaB(HO)₆ ribbon oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. In each H₂ cluster, there are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.76 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. In the NaB(HO)₆ ribbon, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.51 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.33-1.45 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.01 Å. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one B and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one H atom.
